input.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 (branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a run's launch config carries grading_enabled, off when missing, through the ordered launch delivery (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts). T2: settlement of an evaluation execution is fenced to the exact current claim, and completion appends its observation in one transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts, observation/src/grading/worker.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #791 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #791, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/worker.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.
input.title: Automatic grading lifecycle audit

risks.mitigation: Pin and verify the expected head SHA immediately after checkout, and use that SHA in build_result and assessment evidence.
risks.description: The audit subject is named by a movable branch. PR #791 is merged at head db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef, but a later branch move could make the prescribed checkout inspect a different commit.

risks.mitigation: Keep the specified one-run limit and publish the real command, exit status, counts when emitted, and complete failure output; the specification already correctly treats an unrun test as a known issue.
risks.description: The observation package test suite includes PostgreSQL integration tests, so the required single run may fail when the database environment is unavailable.

risks.mitigation: Assess the exact head code: commits 91973743 and db2a5d49 implement the two substantive thread fixes, while the generated-contract concern is explicitly deferred to #792 and is outside T1 and T2.
risks.description: PR #791 is merged but gated-review still reports three open threads, which could be mistaken for three current code defects.

body.summary: The two-task audit is implementable without an operator decision. At PR head db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef, T1 defaults an omitted grading_enabled to false and carries the committed launch config into ordered observation delivery; T2 fences settlement to the current owner, attempt, and unexpired lease and commits execution completion with its grade observation atomically. The sole specification correction recommended is to pin and verify the immutable PR head because the named branch is movable and the current epic/grade-pray tip is not the historical PR comparison base.

findings.description: The revision identity needs an immutable check. Gated-review reports PR #791 MERGED with head db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef and base branch epic/grade-pray. Locally, the current epic tip is a8856584aaaa44017ac1de2cdc710876b1fbb706, the PR branch tip is db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef, and their merge-base is b442f99ccdd68699a346ee55dd9fbe27bc3335d0; therefore a comparison against the current base tip does not reconstruct the historical PR. The builder can proceed, but should verify the checked-out SHA rather than relying only on the branch name.

T1 is directly verifiable at the target commit. oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-10 models grading_enabled as a required boolean, and oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:21-41 defaults an absent value to false while rejecting non-booleans. oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:14-17 accepts the committed run config and oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-49 places it beside the launched input. Separate tests cover the default and delivery in oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83 and oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts:50-65.

The first half of T2 is present. observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:196-227 defines the exact-claim predicate over claimed status, lease owner, claim attempt, and database-time lease validity, acquires the row lock before rereading that predicate, and fences the authoritative update again. observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:304-325 separately exercises expired, reclaimed, and old-attempt claims, and observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:328-357 covers expiry while waiting on the row lock.

The second half of T2 is present. observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:248-255 runs settlement inside the tenant transaction, and observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:267-291 updates the execution and attempt and inserts grade_observation through the same transaction callback. observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-95 passes the exact ExecutionClaim through completion or failure. The rollback behavior is separately tested in observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-243 by forcing observation insertion to fail and verifying that neither completion nor answer persists.

The requested audit remains non-mutating and bounded: the local target ref exists, the root workspace exposes the required observation test script, and no implementation is missing for either task. PR review metadata has three unresolved threads, but the branch head contains the reservation-lock fix at observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:303-315 and the sweep de-duplication fix at observation/src/main.ts:74-90; the remaining generated-contract thread records agreement to defer to #792.

requirements.description: Produce exactly one cohort named audit with exactly two tasks, T1 and T2.
T1 audits grading_enabled from launch config through ordered observation delivery, with false as the absent default.
T2 audits exact-current-claim settlement fencing and atomic completion plus observation append.

The builder performs a read-only detached inspection, runs the observation test command once, reports actual results or a known inability to run, and publishes existing PR #791 without edits, commits, pushes, PR mutations, deployment, or database reset.
The assessor examines the same commit, provides at least one finding for each task, cites source ranges, and reports builder output separately as test evidence.

proposed_spec_updates.change: After the required detached checkout, require verification that HEAD equals db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef, and require both builder and assessor to use that immutable SHA. Clarify that current epic/grade-pray is the worktree starting branch, not the historical diff baseline for the already-merged PR.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: This prevents branch drift or the post-merge squash lineage from changing or confusing the isolated audit subject.
